title: Variables from the Compose project dotenv file are substituted into the YAML but missing inside the container
symptoms: printenv inside the container does not list the variable
docker compose config shows the value already substituted into the file
cause: Compose reads the dotenv file in the project directory only to fill ${VAR} references in the Compose file, and --env-file only changes which file feeds that substitution. Nothing reaches a container unless a service lists it under environment or env_file.
fix: Reference each variable under environment, or point the service at the file with env_file.
apply:
services:
  api:
    env_file: app.env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: ${DATABASE_URL}
affected: Docker Compose v2, as of October 2026
